title: TopoIntent: Compiling Security Intent into Executable, Compliance-Checked Network Topologies
abstract: arXiv:2608.13389v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise security topology design requires translating business intent, regulatory requirements, and risk assumptions into zones, boundary devices, inter-zone paths, and access-control policies. Existing NetOps automation tools mainly operate after this design is fixed, providing limited support for generating structured security topologies from underspecified natural-language requirements. We present TopoIntent, a system that compiles security intent into executable, compliance-checked network topologies. It uses a schema contract to constrain generation, retrieves reference architectures from a curated template library via dense-vector search, and applies staged fusion for intent-template alignment and security completion. The generated topology is checked against CIS Controls v8.1.2 safeguards visible at the topology layer, while unresolved cases are marked for manual review. translated_title: TopoIntent：将安全意图编译为可执行、合规检查的网络拓扑
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13389v1 公告类型：新 摘要：企业安全拓扑设计需要将业务意图、监管要求和风险假设转化为区域、边界设备、区域间路径和访问控制策略。现有的网络运维自动化工具主要在此设计确定后运行，对于从欠规范的自然语言需求生成结构化安全拓扑的支持有限。我们提出了TopoIntent，一个将安全意图编译为可执行、合规检查的网络拓扑的系统。它使用模式契约约束生成，通过密集向量搜索从精选模板库中检索参考架构，并应用分阶段融合进行意图-模板对齐和安全补全。生成的拓扑根据CIS Controls v8.1.2中在拓扑层可见的安全措施进行检查，未解决的问题标记为人工审查。结构缺口通过添加性模式保留修复。
tldr: TopoIntent系统利用模式契约、模板检索和分阶段融合，将自然语言安全意图自动编译为符合CIS Controls v8.1.2的可执行网络拓扑，并标记未决问题供人工审查。
en_tdlr: TopoIntent automatically compiles natural-language security intent into executable network topologies compliant with CIS Controls v8.1.2, using schema contracts, template retrieval, and staged fusion, while flagging unresolved cases for manual review.
